meta.description: Release Intel 'content' mission executor. Acks the dispatch immediately, then expands the seeded content_ideas into a full release calendar/posting schedule/captions/hooks once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and the relevant social credentials are connected, and posts results to POST /api/release-intel/missions/:missionId/callback. Requires n8n env vars DATIAM_API_URL and DATIAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
